title: SourceOS Model Carry Manifest
description: A content-addressed, hash-chained model manifest for the SourceOS model-router carry layer. Names every carried model and adapter with a base-version binding, a targeting predicate, an authoritative SHA-256 content hash, and a policy hash. This is the model-layer analogue of Exodus provenance: model identity is verifiable, not asserted. Integrity failure is a hard stop, not a routing hint. SHA-256 is the authoritative content-hash algorithm (FIPS 180-4).

version.description: Monotonic manifest version. version 1 is the genesis manifest and MUST have a null prevManifestSha256; every later version MUST link the previous manifest by SHA-256.

prevManifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous manifest in the chain, or null for the genesis manifest (version 1).

transportMustBeIntegrityChecked.description: Carried artifacts MUST arrive through integrity-checked transport; unchecked transport is non-conformant.

integrityFailureIsHardStop.description: A carried artifact whose content hash does not match its manifest entry MUST be rejected. Integrity failure is a hard stop surfaced as an uncertainty signal to the decision surface, never a silent fallback.

contentSha256.description: Authoritative SHA-256 of the carried artifact content. Never null: content-addressing is not optional at the manifest layer.

policySha256.description: SHA-256 of the policy object bound to this entry.

targeting.description: Targeting predicate deciding which device class, OS version range, and locale this entry applies to.

baseEntryRef.description: For entryKind=adapter: the entryId of the base this adapter is registered against. Null for entryKind=base.

baseContentSha256.description: For entryKind=adapter: the pinned SHA-256 of the base content this adapter was registered against. Must equal the referenced base entry contentSha256. Null for entryKind=base.
